title: Release v1.36.6 (measured host requirements)
summary: NOT SUBMITTED FOR v1.36.6. This release corrects the installer's host requirements to the values the fleet measurably uses and stops provisioning a swapfile. It changes no consensus state and no transaction execution. It therefore registers no chain upgrade handler and must not schedule a software-upgrade halt. scripts/test_upgrade.sh reads the plan name below, confirms that no matching handler exists, and requires --no-chain-upgrade so the complete deployment and test rehearsal still runs without proposing a halt.
